easyPrerequisites:
It is your precombat main phase.
ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
description:
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Yedora triggers, returning Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Goblin Firestarter enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Firestarter by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Goblin Firestarter face-up.
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability from step 1.
Repeat.
